summary: Two cost steps and a triangle step for Fitting ideals: pass from N to K (cost e bounded by the relLength of the forms modulo the functions vanishing on L), then the triangle with r_j = C·X_j, then the C-torsion cost f; an explicit determinant gives d₄ with the right constant term.

steps.claim: Unpack HasTriangleCost (L, the triangle condition h₂, the length bound h₃); first cost (exists_cost_le_relLength for the functions vanishing on L): K ⊇ N and e with v(e) ≤ relLength, Φ(v) ∈ K for every v killed by the forms, and e·Fitt(K) ⊆ Fitt(N).
steps.lean: h.elim fun L ⟨h₂, h₃⟩ ↦ have ⟨e, K, l, v₁, hL, D₁⟩ := exists_cost_le_relLength z hp hN (.pi L ⊥)

steps.claim: Z: for K' ⊇ K, formsMod Φ z K' p ⊆ formsMod Φ z N p ∩ (functions vanishing on L): a form vanishing on Φ⁻¹(K') vanishes on Φ⁻¹(N), and on L by the choice of K.
steps.lean:
have Z {K'} (k : K ≤ K') : formsMod Φ z K' p ≤ formsMod .. ⊓ .pi L ⊥
    | _, ⟨Ψ, h, rfl⟩ => ⟨⟨Ψ, by tauto⟩, fun _ _ ↦ h (k (by tauto))⟩
steps.typed_fact:
formsMod Φ z K' p ≤ formsMod .. ⊓ .pi L ⊥
    | _, ⟨Ψ, h, rfl⟩ => ⟨⟨Ψ, by tauto⟩, fun _ _ ↦ h (k (by tauto))⟩

steps.claim: The differences of the tie relations at (i, true) and (i, false) lie in K (from hτ).
steps.lean: have W i := by simpa [sub_sub_sub_comm, smul_sub] using l (sub_mem (hτ _) (hτ _))

steps.claim: Triangle (fittingIdeal.triangle with r_j = C·X_j): for j ∈ I, C·X_j·(Φ(zτ(j,true)) − Φ(zτ(j,false))) lies in any T ⊇ K containing the earlier ones (by h₂ through mem_of_forall_form_eq_zero, hI); so some T ⊇ K contains them all with Fitt(T)·∏_{j∈I} C X_j ⊆ Fitt(K).
steps.lean:
have ⟨T, t, hv, D₂⟩ := triangle (C • X ·) fun j hj T t m ↦
    (sub_mem_iff_right _ (mem_of_forall_form_eq_zero hp (by tauto)
    fun c hc ↦ (map_smul ..).trans ((C • c).sub_mem_ker_iff.2 (h₂ j hj _ (Z t ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩) fun i h
    ↦ ⟨c.sub_mem_ker_iff.1 (hc ((sub_mem_iff_left _ ((hI j hj i h).elim (smul_mem _ _ <| m ⟨·, h⟩)
    (by tauto))).1 (t (W i)))), (c.sub_mem_ker_iff.1 <| hc <| m ⟨·, h⟩)⟩)))).1
    (by simpa [smul_sub] using T.smul_of_tower_mem C (t (W j)))

steps.claim: T ⊆ T + (ideal of the constant-term-free polynomials)·⊤.
steps.lean: have l' := le_sup_of_le_left (b := RingHom.ker constantCoeff • ⊤) t

steps.claim: Second cost (exists_cost_le_relLength for the C-torsion): M and f with v(f) ≤ relLength(forms, C-torsion) and f·Fitt(M) ⊆ Fitt(T + …).
steps.lean: have ⟨f, M, k, v₄, hC, D⟩ := exists_cost_le_relLength z hp (l' <| l <| hN ·) (torsionBy O _ C)

steps.claim: The square matrix C·(identity rows e_g, g ∈ s) has rows in M (hs, hC), so its determinant C^{|s|} lies in Fitt(M); hence f·C^{|s|} = d₄ + (constant-term-free) with d₄ ∈ Fitt(T) (fittingIdeal.sup_smul_top_le).

      (M.smul_of_tower_mem C (k (l' (l (hs g))))), rfl⟩)))
